substantive_units.result: Raw criticality excludes all star-support populations contained in one antipodal centre pair, with arbitrary coordinate/parity multiplicity.
Independent raw bitset certificate-relation replay confirms antipodal-pair restrictions under all four orientations; 16 actual D2C family controls and an edge-added negative control pass.

Uniform hand proof excludes every two-centre star support via an isolated separating coordinate pair; all 28 supports pass independent raw-type replay. Thus nonempty star support has at least three distinct centres.
Three cube-symmetry hand cases exclude every three-centre star support; uses clean cube-entry obstruction and unique antipode-bridge capacity. Nonempty star support requires at least four centres.
Independent hostile replay reconstructs all 56 three-centre exclusions, checks cube-isometry coverage, clean entry obstruction and absence of every alternative star-edge certificate.
Structural clean-entry lemma excludes all 56 nonplane four-centre supports. Any four-centre star support must be one of 14 affine planes (three cube-isometry orbits).

Explicit star-forest/parity-plane construction gives an infinite actual D2C family; four-centre support bound is sharp. Dense specialization exists for every n>=20 and has exact M(n)-m=5n-82. All edge types hand-certified; 22 raw graph checks and a negative control pass.

Missing-coordinate matching lemma forces at least five coordinate codes in the parity-plane branch. Sharp n>=19 bound attained by explicit n=19,m=66 graph; denser family for all n>=19 has gap floor((9n-139)/2). Thirty direct graph checks and 66 explicit deletion certificates pass.
